dict.string: FightCamp Wizard uses the camera so you can photograph your food for instant AI nutrition analysis. For example, snap a plate of chicken and rice and the app estimates its calories and macros. You can also scan a product barcode to look up its nutrition, capture photos or videos of your training sessions to attach to your log, and take a profile picture.

FightCamp Wizard uses the microphone for voice dictation so you can speak instead of type. For example, describe a meal out loud to log it, dictate the techniques and reflections from a training session, or talk to the AI recovery coach.

FightCamp Wizard saves images to your photo library when you choose to download a generated share card. For example, saving your weigh-in or walkout result card so you can keep it or post it to social media.

FightCamp Wizard accesses your photo library so you can choose existing photos instead of taking a new one. For example, selecting a meal photo for AI nutrition analysis, attaching photos or videos to a training session log, picking a profile picture, or adding an image to a community post.

FightCamp Wizard uses speech recognition to convert what you say into text. For example, turning a spoken description of your meal or a dictated training session reflection into written notes you can review and edit.
